# Join requests are system lines (no "Name:" sender). Usernames are lower-cased for the reqs flow.
> [VIP] Steve has requested to join the Guild!
= {"kind":"guildJoinRequest","username":"steve"}
> Steve has requested to join the Guild!
= {"kind":"guildJoinRequest","username":"steve"}
> -----------------------------------------------------\n[MVP+] Alex_99 has requested to join the Guild!\nClick here to accept or type /guild accept Alex_99!\n-----------------------------------------------------
= {"kind":"guildJoinRequest","username":"alex_99"}
> [MVP++] Abcdefghijklmnop has requested to join the Guild!
= {"kind":"guildJoinRequest","username":"abcdefghijklmnop"}
> [YOUTUBE] Creator has requested to join the Guild!
= {"kind":"guildJoinRequest","username":"creator"}
> [MVP+] Alex_99 has requested to join the Guild!\nClick here to accept or type /guild accept Alex_99!
= {"kind":"guildJoinRequest","username":"alex_99"}
